title: DragonXriderX---API
description: adds characters who can summon powerful creatures to their side
body:
_Hello, everyone. First of all, I strongly recommend that you download projects through the official curseforge and modrinth launchers—this will increase the reward for the creators. Thank you all very much for your support!!!_

[![chat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7ba56bdea313f30d12390daaabdd4d5e3893385.webp)](https://discord.gg/s8vZR4PGr2)

This mod is a platform that provides units you can hire for a limited time to accompany you on your journey. The main feature of the mod will be add-ons that allow you to summon creatures from other mods of your choice. 
If you want your mercenary to summon dragons from Ice and Fire, simply install the main mod (Ice and Fire), this API mod, and the add-on for this mod related to Ice and Fire.
Currently, we are considering add-ons for mods such as Saint's Dragons,  IceAndFire Community Edition, Dragon Mounts: Even More Dragons, Choup's Drakvyrn Mod. If you have any interesting projects, let me know on my Discord. 

The mod adds the following characters:

DragonXriderXhunteR

![sup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/097a967d1f263f099e20b4a7a6677f60a27e315e.png)

A warrior-hunter who attacks in melee combat using small dragon skeletons on his hands.

![sup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c39b88d96b73e97ad1e0d24e529c73aefdacbf62_0.webp)

DragonXriderXghosT

![sup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09b051c75da66590d47df130c89db139775d6679_0.webp)

A restless warrior,  attacks from a distance with magical projectiles.

The summoning mechanic will be very simple: as the character’s HP decreases, they summon a monster from the add-on to their side, which will be loyal to the summoner.

[![sup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be430e7f950991c85de23828c5efe38f082a33c8.webp)](https://ko-fi.com/iyouroverlord!)
